answer_1.quote: We employ the current state-of-the-art KAT model  as our VQA reader. KAT is a generation-based reader that learns to generate the answer given the retrieved knowledge.

answer_2.quote: We adopt MRR and Precision at a cut-off of 5 as our automatic evaluation metric.

answer_4.quote: We also conducted a human evaluation on AMT of the retrieved entities and sentences to demonstrate that the knowledge retrieved by EnFoRe better supports the correct answers.
answer_4.guideline: workers are asked to judge which system's set of highlighted entities and sentences best supports the given answer.
